name: Fibre / Yarn Preparation & Sizing
description: Conditioning raw fibres, spinning yarns, and applying protective sizing coatings to warp yarns to withstand mechanical abrasion during weaving.
processObjectives: Reduce yarn friction, minimise hairiness, impart tensile strength to warp ends, and eliminate static electricity.

name: Pretreatment & Desizing
description: Removing sizing chemicals, natural waxes, pectins, and lubricating oils from raw fabrics to render fibres hydrophilic and uniformly absorbent.
processObjectives: Complete size removal (Tegewa rating > 6), saponification of natural cotton waxes, high liquor penetration, and absence of crease marks.

name: Bleaching & Whiteness Preparation
description: Oxidative destruction of natural yellow colouring pigments in cotton and cellulosic fibres using controlled hydrogen peroxide baths.
processObjectives: Uniform baseline whiteness, preservation of fibre degree of polymerisation (DP), absence of catalytic pinholes, and complete destruction of residual peroxide.

name: Dyeing & Coloration
description: Applying reactive, disperse, acid, direct, or vat colourants across exhaust or continuous machinery under tightly controlled pH and temperature conditions.
processObjectives: Level dye exhaustion, prevention of unlevel strike, uniform diffusion inside fibre cores, and high shade reproducibility.

name: Textile Printing
description: Localised application of coloured paste containing pigments or reactive dyes using rotary screens, flat screens, or digital printing systems.
processObjectives: Sharp pattern outlines, high print yield, soft surface touch, screen choke resistance, and durable film crosslinking.

name: After-treatment & Washing-Off
description: Thorough washing sequences and chemical fixation designed to remove hydrolysed/unfixed dye molecules and lock colourants into the fibre matrix.
processObjectives: High washing and rubbing fastness (ISO 105), prevention of dye re-deposition, and reduction of rinsing water cycles.

name: Fabric Softening & Finishing
description: Application of conditioning emulsions, silicones, and easy-care resins on stenter frames to achieve specified hand-feel, drape, and dimensional stability.
processObjectives: Target surface softness (silky, bulky, or dry touch), high rewettability where required, minimal stenter yellowing, and tear strength retention.

name: Garment Washing / Special Processing
description: Industrial garment wash house treatments including enzymatic bio-polishing, denim fading, functional finishing (water repellence, moisture wicking), and effluent treatment.
processObjectives: Consistent wash effects, elimination of surface fuzz, specialized technical performance (water/soil resistance), and compliant effluent discharge.
